title: TikTok Expands Features Toward Becoming a Super App
excerpt: TikTok is reportedly working on expanding its platform capabilities, exploring features ranging from restaurant guides to payment systems.
body_html:
Popular social media platform TikTok is reportedly working on expanding its digital offerings to transform into a comprehensive super app. According to recent reports, the platform is exploring a range of services designed to handle multiple digital activities for its users.

Among the features being developed or considered are restaurant guides and digital payment capabilities. By integrating these diverse functions into a single platform, the company appears to be moving toward a model where people can manage a larger portion of their daily online tasks without leaving the app.
